title: Detailed alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left bell -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='24' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f5c842'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='24' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='20' y='29' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#d4a017'/>
  <!-- Right bell -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='24' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f5c842'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='24' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='76' y='29' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#d4a017'/>
  <!-- Hammer between bells -->
  <rect x='47' y='14' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='4' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- Clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='34' fill='#e84545'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='31' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='28' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <!-- 12 -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='30' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- 3 -->
  <rect x='71' y='53.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- 6 -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='74' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- 9 -->
  <rect x='23' y='53.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Minor markers -->
  <rect x='56' y='31.5' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(30 57 33.5)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='31.5' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(-30 43 33.5)'/>
  <rect x='67' y='40' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(60 68 42)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='40' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(-60 32 42)'/>
  <rect x='67' y='66' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(-60 68 68)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='66' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(60 32 68)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='72.5' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(-30 57 74.5)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='72.5' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0c4ff' transform='rotate(30 43 74.5)'/>
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='40' y2='42' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='62' y2='35' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Second hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='45' y2='68' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#e84545'/>
  <!-- Glass shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='44' rx='8' ry='5' fill='rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' transform='rotate(-30 40 44)'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='85' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#d4a017' transform='rotate(15 34 89)'/>
  <rect x='64' y='85' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#d4a017' transform='rotate(-15 66 89)'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f5c842'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f5c842'/>
</svg>
